keptExtendedReplaced.src/adapters/claude.rs: NEW -- ClaudeAdapter implementing c01's HarnessAdapter (plan/apply/verify) against a `home` root + fixed `binary_path`. Registers enforcer_mcp::name::SERVER_NAME (the x01-owned const, never a hardcoded literal) into the top-level mcpServers map of ~/.claude.json via a serde_json::Value merge that preserves every unrelated top-level key AND every unrelated mcpServers entry. Emits .claude/agents/<SERVER_NAME>.md (YAML frontmatter + body, the Claude-native analog of Codex's agents/openai.yaml), ~/.claude/skills/<SERVER_NAME>/SKILL.md, and a CLAUDE.md managed block (crate::managed_block::upsert_block, embedding crate::core::PARALLEL_EXECUTION_DOCTRINE). verify() fails closed (returns the typed InstallError directly, not a passed:false check) on malformed ~/.claude.json; a missing/corrupt descriptor instead renders as a passed:false VerifyCheck (a real, detectable mismatch rather than an unreadable file). Also exposes plan_uninstall/apply_uninstall as inherent methods (kept off the HarnessAdapter trait itself, which core.rs documents as direction-agnostic) for the round-trip proof.

dogfoodFindings: L29 __COMPAT_LAYER=RunAsInvoker confirmed necessary for this crate's own test binary on Windows: `cargo test -p enforcer-install` produced `error 740 (The requested operation requires elevation)` when invoking the compiled test exe (`enforcer_install-*.exe`) without the env var set -- Windows app-compat heuristics flag executables whose name contains "install" for elevation. Setting `__COMPAT_LAYER=RunAsInvoker` in the shell before `cargo test`/`cargo clippy` resolved it with zero code changes required. Documented here since this crate's name (`enforcer-install`) makes every future contributor on Windows hit the identical issue running these exact tests.
